catalog_title: Item-wise monthly HMIS report at District level of Jharkhand

authority.contributor: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Department of Health and Family Welfare
authority.released_under: National Data Sharing and Accessibility Policy (NDSAP)

scientific_value: This authoritative district-level Jharkhand HMIS catalog is a broader acquisition path than the single Pakur subdistrict resource and may support district-month evidence if explicit authoritative payload bytes can be acquired and validated.
next_safe_action: Retry the observed authoritative Catalog API and explicit OGD download surfaces. Admit data only after authoritative payload bytes are obtained, hashed, schema-inspected, temporally interpreted and linked through evidence-backed geography crosswalks.
